name: 个股深研
description_zh: 对单只 A 股生成九维度结构化研究报告：公司近况、核心投资逻辑、催化事件、业务拆分、产销链、财务健康、同业对比、盈利预测与估值、风险提示。适合需要"一页纸看懂一只股票"的场景。
description_en: Generate a nine-dimension structured research report for a single A-share stock — company overview, core investment logic, catalysts, business breakdown, supply-demand chain, financial health, peer comparison, earnings forecast & valuation, and risk alerts. Designed for scenarios requiring a one-page comprehensive view of a stock.
